rationale: I reviewed the actual final option-length distributions and the retained explicit editorial challenges and repairs. The original music category longest-option strategy scored 37.58% expected accuracy with uniform tie breaking and received 14 actual repairs using plausible alternatives of the same type; the independently reviewed music now scores 23.58%. Nature, world geography and food shortest-option clues also received concrete author repairs and independent reviews of changed options. Across these final 1,000 rows, correct versus wrong mean length is 9.828 versus 9.9837 Unicode code points, and uniquely longest correct options occur in 163/1,000 rows. Choosing the longest option with uniform tie breaking scores 23.91%, and shortest scores 25.07%; fixed positions each score 25%. Every category's longest and shortest strategies and tie rules are retained below, alongside overall means. Given the repaired option types, close final full-pack correct and wrong length means and descriptive strategy results, I accept this exact version's requirement that correct answers are not systematically longest. This is an editorial conclusion for these rows, not a statistical guarantee that no imaginable heuristic works. The separately identified deterministic A/B/C/D row-ID pattern now scores 27.80%, replacing its original 100% success; separate final ordered-option review evidence remains required. After two declared late amendments, I actually reread 0515’s Legalism/Confucianism/Daoism/Mohism ordering and 0979’s formal botanical-family target with four real Latin-family alternatives, then recomputed and examined every global and category metric. These are the only two rows differing from the preserved initial final-shuffle manifest; the previous accepted rowset is retained as historical evidence. This length acceptance does not substitute for the independent factual/option rereviews of those two amended rows.
limitations: Descriptive expected accuracy for this fixed dataset is not a confidence interval or a proof against all knowledge-independent heuristics. The length decision does not replace the separate actual per-row factual and ordered-option reviews.
